trigger: human merge of the exact Build 231 pull request followed by a successful exact-release staging deployment
approval_scope: initialize only the blocked Bennett safety launch, internal Safety folder entry, and empty portal assignment control
permitted_actions: authenticate through the live HTTPS staging origin
prepare one internal Safety path in the existing awarded workspace manifest
initialize a blocked six-requirement safety launch shell with unconfirmed applicability
initialize an empty portal assignment control with automatic provisioning disabled
repeat initialization to prove stable content and identity
upload immutable evidence retained for 90 days
prohibited_actions: create or claim an external Google Drive folder
create safety evidence, infer hazards, confirm applicability, or release a safety record
assign, invite, activate, or create a portal user or employee
mark mobilization ready or complete a project-start checklist item
select a vendor, create a commitment, purchase order, actual cost, invoice, or accounting export
issue or externally send any record
change DNS, certificates, secrets, backups, authentication, or infrastructure
